title: Zesty Smoky Mediterranean Onion Skewers
description: A smoky and snappy Mediterranean dish featuring onions, perfect for a lazy Sunday, with a keto-friendly twist, grilled to perfection on a binchotan grill.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the onion pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, whisk together the melted score-fat, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, oregano, salt, pepper, and lemon zest.
Brush the mixture evenly onto both sides of the onion pieces.
Place the skewers on the preheated grill and cook for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the onions are tender and lightly charred.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the onion skewers hot, garnished with additional lemon zest and oregano if desired.
